'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Louvre robbery]]
**Thieves steal part of the [[French Crown Jewels]] from the [[Louvre Museum]] in [[Paris]], [[France]], before fleeing on motorbikes. [[Paris Police Prefecture|Police]] have been unable to locate them. The stolen [[Crown of Empress Eugénie]] is later recovered, although it was damaged. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c78z53v43g1o (BBC News)]
*[[Capital punishment in Iran]], [[Iran–Israel relations]]
**The [[Iran]]ian [[Government of Iran|government]] [[capital punishment|executes]] a person convicted of allegedly spying for Israeli intelligence agency [[Mossad]] in [[Qom]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-israel-spy-execution-68a0a25f3acf1a147046bbb7571cc05a (AP)]

'''Politics and elections''' 
*[[2025 Bolivian general election]]
**[[Centrist]] candidate [[Rodrigo Paz Pereira]] of the [[Christian Democratic Party (Bolivia)|Christian Democratic Party]] defeats [[Independent politician|independent]] [[right-wing politics|right-wing]] candidate and former president [[Jorge Quiroga]] to win the [[President of Bolivia|presidential election]], ending 20 years of [[Movimiento al Socialismo]] rule. [https://apnews.com/article/bolivia-rodrigo-paz-election-quiroga-530aee50c6d63281941079460891da4f (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/who-is-bolivias-new-president-rodrigo-paz-2025-10-20/ (Reuters)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/oct/20/rodrigo-paz-pereira-bolivia-wins-presidential-runoff-electiion-right-wing (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2025 Kuomintang chairmanship election]], [[Cross-strait relations]]
**The [[Taiwan]]ese opposition party [[Kuomintang]] elects [[Cheng Li-wun]] as the new party chairwoman, who is known for her advocacy of closer ties and peace with [[China]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/10/19/taiwan-opposition-elects-new-leader-who-wants-peace-with-china (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2025 Northern Cypriot presidential election]]
**Citizens of the [[breakaway territory]] of [[Northern Cyprus]] vote between incumbent [[Ersin Tatar]] and [[Tufan Erhürman]] to serve as [[President of Northern Cyprus|President]]. [https://famagusta-gazette.com/cyprus-turkish-cypriots-vote-in-first-round-of-leadership-election-in-breakaway-north/ (''Famagusta-Gazette'')]
**Erhürman wins the election with 62.76% of the vote, against Tatar, who received 35.81% of the vote. [https://apnews.com/article/cyprus-election-turkish-cypriots-d5a06aaa7832896284bc54bf3801abed (AP)]
*[[2025 North Macedonian local elections]]
**Citizens of [[North Macedonia]] vote to elect new mayors and cabinets for the country's 80 municipalities. [https://www.slobodenpecat.mk/vo-zhivo-lokalni-izbori-vo-makedonija/ (Sloboden Pecat)]
*Thousands of [[Haredi Judaism|Haredi Jews]] gather around the [[Israel]]i [[consulate]] in [[New York City]], United States, to protest against the potential [[conscription of yeshiva students]] to the [[Israel Defence Forces]], which has been [[religious exemption|exempt]] since 1977.
